property_summary: For any of the three standard interface ids (IERC165, IERC1155, IERC1155MetadataURI) selected by a fuzzed index, C.supportsInterface must return true; the mutant drops the IERC1155 disjunct so it returns false for the IERC1155 id, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Remove the check for the IERC1155 interface id, so callers querying type(IERC1155).interfaceId now get false instead of true.
